    About Ankr

    Ankr provides Web3 infrastructure, including RPC node services and liquid-staking products. ANKR is used to pay for services and to stake with node providers.

    Where this ANKR price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (ANKR-USD), Binance (ANKR/USDT) and Kraken (ANKR/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
